dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.partial: Partial data: some API endpoints unavailable
sources.title: Sources
sources.subtitle: Subscriptions and manual servers (FR-1)
sources.name: Name
sources.noSources: No sources. Add a subscription above or run the first-run wizard.
sources.deleteConflict: Cannot delete: routes reference this source
sources.refreshNote: Background refresh is done by the scheduler; the Refresh button re-reads the list.
servers.title: Servers
servers.subtitle: Unified proxy pool from all sources (FR-3)
servers.noServers: No servers: add a subscription or paste a share link above.
servers.manualHint: Paste one or more share links (vless, trojan, ss, vmess, hysteria2, tuic) — one per line. Parsed by the mihomo converter server-side.
servers.staleHint: Excluded from generation: routes on it report “target lost”
servers.delayTestNote: Periodic delay testing is done by the scheduler (interval in settings). There is no per-server test endpoint in the API yet — the last measured value is shown.
routes.title: Routes
routes.subtitle: Rules in application order (FR-4)
routes.noRoutes: No routes. Apply a template on the Templates tab or create a route.
routes.conditionsHint: All conditions are AND-ed. For src-device pick a LAN device with the “Devices” button.
routes.lanUnavailable: LAN device list unavailable (endpoint not wired or empty lease file)
templates.title: Templates
templates.subtitle: Ready-made rule sets (FR-5)
templates.deleted: Template deleted (the builtin one is restored if this was an override)
templates.confirmDelete: Delete template “{name}”? If it overrides a builtin, the shipped version returns after deletion.
templates.editor.idHint: lowercase letters/digits/hyphen, 1–64 chars; used as the file name
templates.editor.name: Name
templates.editor.conditionsHint: All conditions are AND-ed. For geosite — the list category (e.g. youtube); suggestions come from the local geosite.dat.
groups.title: Groups
groups.subtitle: User proxy groups (FR-3.3)
groups.noGroups: No groups. Create one from the pool servers.
groups.membersRequired: At least one member is required
groups.membersHint: Pool servers and groups; selection order = fallback order.
groups.noPool: The pool is empty: add a subscription or manual servers first.
logs.title: Logs & diagnostics
logs.subtitle: Application and nikki/mihomo logs, service checks (FR-9.2/FR-9.4)
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Global parameters (FR-9.1)
settings.additionsHint: Your own domains/IPs appended to geosite/geoip categories. Addition rules point at the same target as the route using that category.
settings.additionsNote: Key: geosite:<category> (domains, one per line) or geoip:<category> (CIDRs). Additions for categories no route uses are ignored at generation.
settings.defaultPolicyHint: What happens to traffic matched by no route
settings.profileHint: Current state generated into a mihomo profile (FR-4.9)
settings.backupHint: Export the state to a JSON file (the HWID is not included — it is tied to this device). Import fully replaces the current state after validation.
settings.wizardHint: First-run wizard: subscription, default policy, first template
settings.sourcesHint: Full URLs are hidden (they are secrets). The toggle enables/disables a source; the full list lives on the Sources tab.
settings.noSources: No sources. Import from nikki or add a subscription on the Sources tab.
wizard.title: First run
wizard.step1.title: Add a subscription
wizard.step1.text: Subscription URL from your panel (Remnawave-compatible). Servers enter the pool after the scheduler updates.
wizard.step2.title: Default policy
wizard.step2.text: What happens to traffic matched by no route. Changeable later in settings.
wizard.step3.title: First template
wizard.step3.text: Ready-made rule set. “Ads & trackers — block” is the safest start.
wizard.name: Name
wizard.doneText: WellBoard is configured. Everything else lives in the tabs.
wizard.hint: Simplified wizard: 3 steps, no client-side URL validation — the server validates and returns the error if anything is wrong.
apply.applyHint: Generate the profile, validate (mihomo -t), write and restart with a health check
monitoring.title: Monitoring
monitoring.subtitle: metacubexd: connections, traffic, core logs (FR-8)
monitoring.missingText: The metacubexd monitoring UI has not been fetched to this stand. Run in the repo root:
monitoring.hint: The ~8 MB dist is not kept in git (DECISIONS D18). Without it all other tabs work fully.
routes.extHint: Rules from the active mihomo config (/etc/nikki/run/config.yaml). WellBoard never modifies or applies them: this tab only reads the file. 'Import' copies one rule into WellBoard as a route (created disabled).
routes.extImported: OK: rule copied as route {id} (disabled; enable and Apply at will)
routes.extEmpty: No external rules found (config file missing or has no rules section).
